items.title: Chern classes of the twist of a finite locally free sheaf by an invertible sheaf

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma computes the Chern classes of the twist of a finite locally free sheaf of rank r by an invertible sheaf as a binomial combination of the Chern classes of the original sheaf and powers of the first Chern class of the invertible sheaf (statement lines 7754-7769, tag 02UD). The proof reduces to an integral base by the vanishing criterion, invokes the canonical morphism between the two projective bundles together with the relation between their twisting sheaves, writes the characterising relation of the Chern classes of the twist, and then performs a genuine algebraic manipulation with binomial coefficients to compare that relation with the universal one and extract the formula. The algebra of that comparison is the substance, so the claim is H2.
